summary: Five Codex sessions used goal mode, parallel ownership, ultra effort and Fast mode to turn a rejected stub into an evidence-linked MuJoCo replay page. Withdrawn runs remain labeled as withdrawn.

hours.basis: wall_clock_night is elapsed UTC duration from the run start; summed_session_hours is the sum of the five recorded tmux session lifetimes.

subagents_note: These are three subagents of the main session; all commits carry one git author and lanes are assigned by touched files, not by session.

sessions.name: main
sessions.owns: simulator core, seeded scenes, rollout API, measured expert, benchmark, and rendered replay
sessions.hours_basis: tmux session dryrun created 2026-11-14T18:00:08Z; observed at 2026-11-15T01:47Z
sessions.commit_count_basis: git log --name-only path attribution at this snapshot; film-plan commits and reverts are other
sessions.biggest_result: Integrated the measured reference recipe, then moved the page evidence to seeded multi-brick scenes after the one-brick loose tier was withdrawn.
sessions.worst_miss: The first expert was slow/broken and the fixed-scene loose tier was withdrawn as rigged before the measured recipe replaced it.

sessions.name: inspector
sessions.owns: defect generation, inspection renders, good-only anomaly model, and OpenVINO evaluation
sessions.hours_basis: tmux session dr-inspector created 2026-11-14T18:59:43Z; observed at 2026-11-15T01:47Z
sessions.commit_count_basis: git log --name-only path attribution at this snapshot; film-plan commits and reverts are other
sessions.biggest_result: Real present crops plus PatchCore accepted all 328 good bricks and detected all 241 defective bricks in the 569-brick held-out set.
sessions.worst_miss: The first inspector attempt was rejected for false rejects; it had to be retrained and evaluated on real good frames.

sessions.name: page
sessions.owns: replay export, real SO-101 viewer, camera videos, telemetry, dashboard, deployment, and browser smoke
sessions.hours_basis: tmux session dr-page created 2026-11-14T18:59:43Z; observed at 2026-11-15T01:47Z
sessions.commit_count_basis: git log --name-only path attribution at this snapshot; film-plan commits and reverts are other
sessions.biggest_result: The deployed page now shows the recorded MuJoCo SO-101 replay, synced top and inspection cameras, and a two-viewport browser smoke gate.
sessions.worst_miss: Several page passes were rejected for showing stubs or a broken first screen before the real replay and error gate were installed.

sessions.name: policy
sessions.owns: demo recorder, LeRobot data, ACT training, Modal evaluation, and policy telemetry
sessions.hours_basis: tmux session dr-policy created 2026-11-14T19:25:21Z; observed at 2026-11-15T01:47Z
sessions.commit_count_basis: git log --name-only path attribution at this snapshot; film-plan commits and reverts are other
sessions.biggest_result: Produced a real LeRobot dataset and recorded ACT checkpoints with per-stage held-out evaluation and CPU/OpenVINO timing.
sessions.worst_miss: The first 64-pixel, 201-step run reached no physical rollout stage on any checkpoint; it is retained as a failed run, not a success.

sessions.name: analyst
sessions.owns: 448 px Nemotron failure analysis, strict scoring, sentence stations, worker, and evidence docs
sessions.hours_basis: tmux session dr-analyst created 2026-11-14T19:25:21Z; observed at 2026-11-15T01:47Z
sessions.commit_count_basis: git log --name-only path attribution at this snapshot; film-plan commits and reverts are other
sessions.biggest_result: Built the strict 448×448 four-field runner and kept a live 300-failure run, while the station gallery retained 32 accepted layouts and four rejection reasons.
sessions.worst_miss: The earlier 32 px Nemotron score was not visual evidence and is explicitly withdrawn from benchmark use.

features.name: goal mode
features.evidence: The overnight objective and goal-mode instruction are recorded at the start of the run.

features.name: parallel sessions
features.evidence: Five named work streams were kept in separate tmux sessions with explicit ownership.

features.name: ultra effort with delegation
features.evidence: The supervisor set ultra effort and delegation for every stream from 19:30 UTC; the session ledger records the assignments.

features.name: Fast mode
features.evidence: Used on all five sessions; the one-run comparison was 28.53 s without the Fast tier and 22.42 s with it, 6.11 s sooner (21.4%), with identical output.

features.name: models by job
features.evidence: Astra was assigned to geometry and spatial checks; Sol to build, page, inspector and policy work; Nemotron supplied the analyst model.

features.name: codex review
features.evidence: codex review found why the learned policy scored zero: every action chunk was one action repeated, paired with the next frame. After the fix it reaches 9 of 20 bricks.

features.name: browser use
features.evidence: The deployed page was opened and smoke-tested at desktop and phone widths; the script checks console errors, videos and scroll width.

features.name: AGENTS.md
features.evidence: Repository contributor rules were read and followed; the file is tracked at the repository root.

timeline.event: Goal mode and evidence-led run started.
First pass rejected: a 245-line stub was claiming milestones without MuJoCo, physics, or real outputs.
Zero-pickup/grasp problem measured on varied SO-101 poses.
Bowl overlap found and made a failing station check.
The fixed-scene loose tier was marked rigged and withdrawn.
Rollout API and event/result contract completed.
Closed-form SO-101 position IK and reach margin gates landed.
First inspector matrix was labeled and rejected before real-frame retraining.
Measured grasp recipe replaced tuning and became the expert path.
Measured reference recipe was checked; the one-brick loose release was later withdrawn from benchmark use.
Real multi-brick messy and pile tiers were generated with replay evidence.
Cluster-pushing reference expert was added for touching and pile scenes.
Policy page data recorded the first ACT checkpoints and honest zero-stage results.
Real-frame inspector evidence was published after the first attempt was rejected.
Analyst page artifacts and high-resolution failure evidence were published.
Live tier payload and camera visibility were guarded after the page repair round.
